mcqs.question: What is the key feature of India's first State-level AP MSME Exchange approved in Andhra Pradesh?
options: MSMEs can raise capital through IPOs
MSMEs receive compulsory government grants
MSMEs can raise capital only through bank loans
MSMEs are given free industrial plots without listing
mcqs.explanation: The AP MSME Exchange is India's first State-level MSME Exchange and enables MSMEs to raise capital through IPOs. The most tempting alternative is bank loans, but the exchange specifically provides an IPO-based capital-raising route.

mcqs.question: What is the principal objective of Andhra Pradesh's MSME parks initiative launched at the MSME Growth Summit 2026?
options: To establish one MSME park in every Assembly constituency
To establish 38 MSME parks only in Vijayawada
To establish 37 MSME parks only in Nandyal district
To establish one MSME park only in every coastal district
mcqs.explanation: The initiative aims to establish one MSME park in every Assembly constituency, covering all 175 constituencies. The figure 38 refers to the parks virtually launched at the summit, not the ultimate statewide objective.

mcqs.question: Under the scheme for DWCRA women announced by the Andhra Pradesh Minister for MSME, SERP and NRI Empowerment, what loan facility is provided?
options: A collateral-free loan of up to ₹10 lakh to start or expand MSME units
A loan of up to ₹10 lakh requiring collateral to start or expand MSME units
A collateral-free loan of up to ₹10 lakh exclusively for government employment
A collateral-free loan of up to ₹10 lakh exclusively for purchasing agricultural land
mcqs.explanation: The scheme provides DWCRA women collateral-free loans of up to ₹10 lakh for starting or expanding MSME units. The closest trap is the option requiring collateral, whereas the scheme specifically removes the collateral requirement.

mcqs.question: Andhra Pradesh has approximately 25% of India's beach sand mineral reserves. Which State has a larger reserve share than Andhra Pradesh?
options: Tamil Nadu
Andhra Pradesh
West Godavari
Krishna
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh has about 25% of India's beach sand mineral reserves and ranks second only to Tamil Nadu. West Godavari and Krishna are coastal belts in Andhra Pradesh, not the State ranked ahead of it.

mcqs.question: Which process best explains the formation of beach sand mineral placer deposits along the Andhra Pradesh coast?
options: Godavari and Krishna carry sediments, while waves and tides concentrate heavy minerals
Srikakulam and Visakhapatnam carry sediments, while rainfall concentrates light minerals
Gara and Etcherla carry sediments, while rivers concentrate agricultural minerals
West Godavari and Konaseema carry sediments, while winds concentrate industrial minerals
mcqs.explanation: The Godavari and Krishna carry sediments, and waves and tides concentrate the heavy minerals into placer deposits. The other options replace the rivers or the heavy-mineral concentration process with details not associated with the stated formation mechanism.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding selected beach sand minerals and their uses.

List-I
(a) Ilmenite
(b) Rutile
(c) Monazite
(d) Garnet

List-II
(i) Abrasive used in sandblasting and waterjet cutting
(ii) Rare earth elements and thorium
(iii) Titanium dioxide used in paints, plastics and paper
(iv) Higher-grade titanium ore used for titanium metal
options: a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i
a-iv, b-iii, c-i, d-ii
a-ii, b-i, c-iv, d-iii
a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are ilmenite–titanium dioxide, rutile–higher-grade titanium ore, monazite–rare earth elements and thorium, and garnet–abrasive use. The other codes interchange these mineral-use relationships.

mcqs.question: Which pairing correctly identifies the Andhra Pradesh recipients of the Padma Shri 2026 and their fields?
options: Garimella Balakrishna Prasad—devotional music; Vempaty Kutumba Sastry—Sanskrit scholarship
Garimella Balakrishna Prasad—Sanskrit scholarship; Vempaty Kutumba Sastry—devotional music
Garimella Balakrishna Prasad—devotional music; Vempaty Kutumba Sastry—devotional music
Garimella Balakrishna Prasad—Sanskrit scholarship; Vempaty Kutumba Sastry—Sanskrit scholarship
mcqs.explanation: Garimella Balakrishna Prasad was recognised for devotional music and the revival of Annamacharya Sankeerthanams, while Vempaty Kutumba Sastry was recognised as a Sanskrit scholar. The tempting reversed pairing incorrectly exchanges their fields.
